You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: Clearing the combobox never calls onChange(null), so the selection can't be cleared.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [minor] `FEATURE_FLOW.md` is listed in FILES but does not exist in the repo and is not in the diff. Not reproduced as a defect in the code; it is a scope question.
- [minor] The "No results" message is a `role="status"` div placed beside the listbox, not inside it. The spec only requires that it is not a `role="option"`, so this passes, but a reviewer may want it inside the listbox. Not reproduced as a failure.
- [minor] Tab disables via the native `disabled` attribute and never sets `aria-disabled`. T5 allows either, so this is not a failure.
- [minor] Option ids use the index into the full `options` array, so they shift when options are reordered while open. Not reproduced as a problem, since `aria-activedescendant` is recomputed on each render.

Reply exactly:
{"found": "yes"|"no", "finding_quote": "<verbatim quote of the matching finding, or empty>", "blocking": "yes"|"no"}
"blocking" is "yes" only if the matching finding is tagged [blocking].
